pattern: Segmented month field in a labelled group with a button that opens a non-modal dialog popup (WAI-ARIA APG date picker dialog pattern, non-modal variant) containing a paged role=grid of months with a roving tabindex.

aria.value: Help text and visible error message ids
"true" only while an error message is shown
"Choose month", or "Change month, {value}" (for example "Change month, March 2026") when a value is set
polite (announces the year when the page changes)
"true" when the page reaches min/max or year 1/9999 (focus stays on the button)
Long month and year, for example "March 2026"
"true" on the selected month only (absent otherwise)
"date" on the current month (configured timezone or today option)
"true" for months outside min/max or rejected by isMonthDisabled

keyboard.action: Enters up to two digits; a first digit 2-9 is padded (4 becomes 04) and advances; a first 1 waits for a second digit. Non-digits are removed.
Enters up to four digits and advances when full; fewer than four digits is incomplete.
Pads a single-digit month and advances to the next segment.
Month increments or decrements with wrap (1-12); the year stops at 1 and 9999. An empty month starts at 01 (Up) or 12 (Down); an empty year starts at the current year.

keyboard.context: Caret at the segment edge, or text selected
keyboard.action: Previous or next segment in the visual order of the LTR-isolated segment run (not mirrored in RTL).
Opens the popup without changing the segment.
Moves through the segments, then the button.
Opens the popup (or closes it when open); focus moves to the selected month, else the current month, clamped to min/max.
Next / previous month (mirrored in RTL), crossing into the adjacent year.
Same column in the next / previous row (plus or minus 3 months), crossing into the adjacent year.
First / last month of the row.
Same month in the next / previous year.

Picks the month unless it is disabled; with closeOnSelect (default) the popup closes and focus returns to the button, otherwise focus stays on the cell. Emits aui-change if the value or validity changed.
Shows the previous / next year; no-op while aria-disabled.
Closes the popup without changing the value; focus inside the popup returns to the button. Only the topmost overlay responds, so a surrounding Dialog stays open.
Moves between the previous and next year buttons and the focused month; focus leaving the popup (other than to the choose button) closes it.

focus: Each segment and the button are tab stops. Opening moves focus to one month cell (roving tabindex: exactly one cell has tabindex=0). Movement is clamped to min/max and years 1-9999; disabled months stay focusable. Picking with closeOnSelect, Escape, and closing through the button return focus to the button; focus is moved before the popup hides, so it never falls to the document body. A pointer press outside the popup and the button closes it. Moving focus between the segments, button, and popup does not mark the field touched.
notes: The label is a <label> associated through aria-labelledby because a group is not labelable; clicking the label focuses the first segment.
The required asterisk is aria-hidden; each segment carries the native required state.
The segments remain the primary input; the grid is an alternative, and a typed month rejected by isMonthDisabled gets a localized message so both paths agree.
The popup is non-modal: focus is not trapped and the rest of the page stays reachable.
Errors appear after focus leaves the whole control by default, so moving between segments does not trigger messages.
knownCaveats: Screen-reader behavior (dialog announcement, page changes, cell states) has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
Segment arrow navigation follows visual order and is not mirrored in RTL, because segments render as an LTR run.
